bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders or paid parking in marked bays
bays.times: Controlled hours are set by each zone's Traffic Order and shown on the zone entry signs — Barnet does not publish a per-zone hours table
bays.tariff: On-street pay-by-phone (Barnet Council Fees and Charges 2026/27): Tariff 5 in the main centres — £5.10 per hour (30 min £2.55, max stay varies), Monday to Saturday 8am–6.30pm; Tariff 9 elsewhere — £2.20 per hour (first 15 minutes free, 30 min £1.10), Monday to Saturday 7am–midnight. The bay sign and the PayByPhone app show which tariff applies. Paid parking does not apply on Sundays or bank holidays except on event days

Tariff 5 (Barnet Fees and Charges 2026/27): 15 minutes £1.30; 30 minutes £2.55; 1 hour £5.10; 2 hours £10.20; 3 hours £15.30; 4 hours £20.40. Charges apply Monday to Saturday 8am–6.30pm; paid parking does not apply on Sundays or bank holidays except on event days

bays.times: Charging hours as signed at the car park
bays.tariff: Tariff 9 (Barnet Fees and Charges 2026/27): first 15 minutes free; 30 minutes £1.10; 1 hour £2.20; 2 hours £4.40; 3 hours £6.60; 4 hours £8.80

bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders only in marked bays during the controlled hours
bays.tariff: Visitor parking permit (virtual, bought by a resident of the zone): £3 per permit, valid until 23:59 on the day it is activated; book of 10 permits £30. Half price (£1.50 per permit, £15 per book) for eligible residents. Up to 100 visitor permits per household per year.
bays.pay: Visitor permits via the council's online permit account; some streets in the zone also have pay-and-display / PayByPhone bays
